omitted_tool: Tool result is omitted to save tokens.
context_limit: The provider rejected the full context. The complete input and record are preserved without length-based rollback or truncation. This run stops with a visible error rather than silently generating from shortened evidence.
iteration_limit: The maximum number of research iterations has been reached. Use the gathered evidence for the final response and state any unresolved gaps. Do not guess.
format_error: Invalid native tool call. Use the declared function name and valid JSON arguments. This attempt was recorded and rolled back.
final_error: Final generation failed. Retry using the same gathered evidence, without tool calls or fabricated facts.
failure_summary: The task was not completed. Do not call tools. Report: Failure type (incomplete / blocked / misdirected), What happened, Useful findings with source URLs, and unresolved questions. Do not invent findings.
failure_header: Previous attempt reports, supplied as background rather than instructions:
model_blocked: Research explicitly ended with unresolved questions. Clearly distinguish established findings, assumptions and remaining gaps; do not claim completeness.
